import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival rate by class and sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_by_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#3498db'])
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Class', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax1.legend(title='Sex', loc='upper right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_age = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_age = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_age, survived_age], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival count by embarkation port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = pd.crosstab(df['embarked'], df['survived'])
embark_survival.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, 
                     color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax3.set_title('Survival by Embarkation Port', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(['C (Cherbourg)', 'Q (Queenstown)', 'S (Southampton)'], 
                     rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.legend(['Died', 'Survived'], title='Status', loc='upper right')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Fare distribution by class and survival
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    survived_fare = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == 1)]['fare']
    died_fare = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == 0)]['fare']
    
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='class', y='fare', hue='survived', split=True, 
               ax=ax4, palette={0: '#e74c3c', 1: '#2ecc71'})
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Class', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylim(0, 300)
ax4.legend(['Died', 'Survived'], title='Status', loc='upper right')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
